notes.title: Meet the update!
notes.content:
The [b]1.0[/b] update has been released, adding Russian language voice acting to the game!

Many thanks to the cast for all their hard work and great patience - the work stretched over a long period of time and turned out to be not dusty at all :3

There's a [b]20%[/b] discount for the new version - don't miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41490398/f7510c5e96f8f9b4c0043d6bde45aebc824d8b18.png[/img]

notes.title: Now in English!
notes.content:
My Cashy Side Job is now available on English! Let it snow and let's play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41490398/be53f1b4f7935ebebddfd46da97cd9e5408b6224.png[/img]

notes.title: The English version will be available soon!
notes.content: The English version will be released in the next few weeks! Stay tuned :3
